elements.name: Mattermost server
elements.description: Serves REST commands/history, authorizes channel access, stores posts and delivers live events. One modular Go application, replicated at deployment.

elements.name: Web client
elements.description: Browser client using the REST API and a persistent WebSocket connection. Page composition is outside this architecture study.

elements.name: Job server
elements.description: Runs scheduled and background jobs using the same server codebase in a separate process role. Job status is persisted in PostgreSQL.

elements.name: Application database
elements.description: Authoritative users, teams, channels, posts, file metadata and job records. Writer/reader placement remains in the preserved source.

elements.name: Shared file storage
elements.description: Shared attachment bytes and export/import objects; access and file metadata remain in the application. All server replicas use the same backend.

elements.name: Mobile push service
elements.description: Mattermost hosted push service forwards notifications to mobile push providers. Mobile UI is outside this study.

elements.name: Email service
elements.description: Delivers mention and offline notifications through configured SMTP. Selected from the application architecture, beyond the AWS diagram's core boxes.

requirements.summary: Messaging, web files, notifications and database-polled jobs only. Calls, plugins, desktop/mobile internals and advanced search are excluded.
